title: jmri-json-rosterEntry-client-message
description: Schema data object in message from client to JMRI for type "rosterEntry"

address.description: If present, set the DCC address of the rosterEntry

road.description: If present, set the owning railroad of the rosterEntry

number.description: If present, set the owning railroad roster number of the rosterEntry

mfg.description: If present, set the manufacturer of the device in the rosterEntry

model.description: If present, set the model of the device in the rosterEntry

maxSpeedPct.description: If present, set the maximum speed of the rosterEntry as a percentage

shuntingFunction.description: If present, set the function key that triggers shunting capability; null clears it

owner.description: If present, set the owner of the device in the rosterEntry; null clears it, which resets it to the default owner if one is set

comment.description: If present, set the comment for the rosterEntry; null clears it

functionKeys.description: If present, set the label and lockable state of each listed function key

name.description: Function key; must not be above the rosterEntry's highest function number

label.description: Label for function key; null clears it

attributes.description: If present, replaces the additional properties of the rosterEntry; any attribute not listed is removed

name.description: Key by which attribute is accessed

value.description: String value of attribute or null
